EmailTemplate.name: Application Approved
EmailTemplate.subject: Your Wadhwani Grants application is approved

Hello {!Account.FirstName},
Congratulations — your application has been approved.
I'm delighted to share that {!Account.WCF_Organizational_Name__c}'s application has been approved. We're looking forward to partnering with you.
As your point of contact at Wadhwani Grants, I'll guide you through onboarding, agreements, and next steps.
View next steps: https://wadhwanifoundation--wfdev.sandbox.my.site.com/wcf/s/applicant-portal
Warm regards, {!Account.PL_of_Record__r} Wadhwani Grants
Questions? [grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org](mailto:grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org)
